decision.question: QA2 execution backend: in-process scheduler versus durable-execution engine
decision.recommendation: in-process scheduler (current AgentOS coordinator, ADR-0002); the durable engine is documented provider-neutral as a single-writer stateful boundary (event history + transactional outbox inside) with measurable migration triggers
decision.sensitivity: 222 deterministic runs (16 per-dimension weight +-50% perturbations, 200 seeded random integer weight compositions); zero winner flips

probes.A_unsafe_resume: REJECTED - resume re-executed a real external effect and force-appended a second receipt through the production simulator path; FAIL regardless of latency or recovery advantage
probes.B_incomparable: REJECTED as INCOMPARABLE/NO_DATA - the candidate's workload hash diverged from the frozen manifest; it can never win
probes.C_blind_retry: REJECTED - unknown external outcomes retried without recorded reconciliation evidence; FAIL

decision.migration_trigger: revisit only when a measurable trigger fires: sustained load beyond the single-process S1-002 envelope (10-100 ev/s research band), an availability-domain requirement, or a new trust boundary; the durable prototype starts with the state boundary (event history + outbox inside a single-writer component) and re-runs this frozen benchmark before any migration; rollback is trivial (no core change landed)
decision.non_goals: no production Temporal/Cadence/Step Functions installation, no vendor/cloud choice, no production SLO or availability claims, no core runtime changes, no SQLite/Postgres or S1-005 topology re-decision

limitations: Model-based comparison on a same-host research station: durable-engine costs combine S1-005 E1/E2 measurements with documented lease/visibility assumptions (100 ms lease timeout, 105 ms modeled recovery); no vendor engine was installed.
S1-002 is not a production SLO and S1-005 measurements are same-host bounded; multi-host partition behaviour and vendor timer semantics are unknown and excluded from scoring.

The durable-engine candidate scored 0 on crash-recovery-time and 1 on throughput-latency under the frozen linear ratio mapping; this is a documented extreme of the modelled lease timeout, not a measured production gap.
Producer and verifier labels are process-separated roles in one local environment, not external human auditors.
Migration triggers are symbolic until the follow-up benchmark measures them.
note: research-plan PASS_WITH_LIMITS is a research evaluation; it never sets Goal ACCEPTED (release gate only)
